data.bio: Clyde is a devoted husband and father who has built a blended family with his wife Mary. Together they have two children, Liam and Roland, and Clyde has two children from a previous marriage - Clyde Jr. and Cynthia - whose mother is Annie. Clyde works as a construction supervisor and takes pride in providing for all of his children. He values the relationships he has with both his current family and his children from his previous marriage, working hard to maintain strong bonds with all of them.
